verdict.rationale: AWS docs explicitly describe leasing dedicated IPs and a 'Managed' dedicated IP option that 'automatically warm up for each ISP individually and auto-scale based on your sending volume,' directly matching the story's need for automated ramp-up when outgrowing shared pools. This is first-party documentation with no independent hands-on corroboration of the warmup mechanics in this pack. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the warmup process, and detail on the published manual warmup schedule for non-managed dedicated IPs.
